answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to a remotely attested enclave measurement, specifically Intel SGX MRENCLAVE, or an equivalent AMD SEV-SNP measurement, and accepted only when platform evidence verifies the expected code. Copying keys or running the same image in virtual machines cannot reproduce a distinct attested identity; cloning identities therefore requires purchasing additional physical silicon rather than duplicating virtual machines across violet, jetty, and tundra deployments.
